notes: kb/Work PB369, PB5080, PB5139. Rule text (cite.py --check "§2023:14.9.46.3 SR2" "shall contain a GLOBAL clause" -> OK). The rule begins at 2002 (§2002:14.8.42.2 SR2, §2014:14.9.42.2 SR2; each checked with cite.py --check), so the row's editions are 2002, 2014 and 2023. There the TERMINATE is refused COBOL2392 by the shared RejectContainedReportFile when the FD is not GLOBAL, citing the rule of the edition compiled; the legal shape (GLOBAL RD on a GLOBAL FD, TERMINATE in a grandchild) runs in conformance:cases/13.18.27-GLOBAL/pb369_global_report_use_selection. 1985's TERMINATE asks only that report-name-1 be defined by a report description entry (§1985:XIII.4.7.3 SR1), and a global name may be referenced without describing it again (§1985:X.4.6.4 GR2), so --std 85 accepts it (kb/Work PB5080).
